tokens.overview.text: Tokens are CSS custom properties that hold every visual value in Love.css. No component hardcodes a color, radius, or spacing. Change a token and every place that uses it updates.
tokens.levels.title: Three levels
tokens.levels.primitives.desc: Raw values, never change per theme.
tokens.override.title: How to override
tokens.override.text: Put your rules in love.overrides.css. It loads last, so your values win without !important.
tokens.spacing.title: Spacing scale
tokens.spacing.text: Based on 0.25rem increments. Every gap, padding, and margin in the framework comes from here.
tokens.oklch.title: Why oklch
tokens.oklch.text: Colors use oklch() instead of hex or rgb. Oklch is perceptually uniform: a change of 0.1 in lightness looks the same at any hue. This makes light/dark theme swaps trivial.
tokens.three_levels.title: Why three levels
tokens.three_levels.text: Primitives give you a palette. Semantics give you roles. Components give you control points. Three levels let you change one thing without touching the rest.
themes.overview.text: Three themes: light, dark, and high-contrast. Themes only redefine semantic tokens. No component changes.
themes.activating.title: Activating
themes.row.high_contrast: Pure black on white, black borders.
themes.color_scheme.title: Why color-scheme
themes.color_scheme.text: Native form controls — <select>, <input type="date">, scrollbars — are drawn by the browser. Setting color-scheme: dark tells the browser to use its dark palette. Without it, they stay bright white inside a dark page.
themes.notes.li1: Theme tokens are declared on :root, [data-love-theme], and inside a prefers-color-scheme media query. Three ways to resolve — always check all three if a color looks wrong.
themes.notes.li2: To add a custom theme, create [data-love-theme="sepia"] in love.overrides.css and override the same tokens.
fonts.overview.text: Space Grotesk, a variable font by Florian Karsten, under SIL Open Font License 1.1. One file covers all weights from 300 to 700.
fonts.replacing.title: Replacing the font
fonts.swap.title: Why font-display: swap
fonts.swap.text: Without it, the browser shows blank text for up to three seconds. With swap, it renders the fallback font immediately and swaps when ready.
reset.overview.text: Combines normalize.css v8 with Eric Meyer's reset. Fixes cross-browser inconsistencies and removes default margins and paddings, so every browser starts from the same baseline.
reset.does.title: What it does
reset.does.li4: Removes link decoration and color (styling is base.css).
base.overview.text: Base styles every bare HTML element. No classes required. Headings, paragraphs, lists, blockquotes, code, tables, figures — all get sensible defaults from tokens.
base.what.title: What gets styled
base.row.headings: Semibold, tight line-height, growing top margin.
base.row.a: Primary color, underline on hover, grape for :visited.
base.notes.li1: base.css targets elements, not classes. For one-off changes, use a class in overrides, not a new base rule.
base.notes.li2: The prefers-reduced-motion block at the bottom disables all animations globally, including anything you add in overrides.
layout.overview.text: Layout primitives for page structure. No styling, only positioning. All responsive by default.
layout.row.row: Horizontal flex with gap and wrap.
layout.row.center: Centers a single child both axes.
layout.row.grid_auto: Auto-fit grids with minimum cell sizes.
layout.row.full_bleed: Escapes container padding to full viewport width.
utilities.overview.text: Single-purpose classes for one-off adjustments. Use them when writing a new CSS rule would be overkill. Do not use them for everything — the framework is not utility-first.
utilities.categories.title: Categories
utilities.row.text: Text alignment, color, size, weight, transform.
animations.overview.text: Simple CSS animations only. Entrance effects, spinners, shimmer. Anything requiring JS orchestration, scroll-driven timelines, or physics is outside Love.css.
animations.classes.title: Available classes
animations.transform.title: Only transform and opacity
animations.transform.text: Every keyframe animates only transform and opacity. These are handled by the compositor thread, so animations stay smooth even when JS is busy.
button.overview.text: Styles every clickable element: <button>, <a>, and <input type="submit">. Six variants, three sizes, icon-only, button groups, loading state, toggle state.
button.row.primary: The main action on the page.
button.notes.li1: Active state uses grape, not primary. Pressing is not the same as selecting.
button.notes.li2: The spinner uses currentColor with explicit color overrides for primary/danger/success backgrounds.
button.notes.li3: Reduced motion slows the spinner to 1.5s instead of removing it.
card.overview.text: Containers for grouped content: header, body, optional footer. Variants control shadow, border, hover, and accent stripes.
card.row.card: Base container with border and shadow.
card.row.title: Heading with no outer margin.
card.row.subtitle: Small muted text under title.
card.row.text: Body text with consistent top margin.
card.row.interactive: Cursor and focus ring for clickable cards.
form.overview.text: Styles every field, label, hint, error message, checkbox, and radio. Consistent across browsers, correct in dark theme via color-scheme.
form.row.label: Field label.
form.row.check_hint: Secondary line under a check label.
form.row.rows: Grid of fields. Collapses on mobile.
table.overview.text: Tables with stripes, hover, borders, compact mode, sticky header, responsive scroll, and selected/disabled rows.
table.row.bordered: Borders on all sides of every cell.
table.row.sticky: Header sticks to top on scroll.
alert.overview.text: Inline messages with a colored left border. Five variants. Optional close button.
alert.row.title: Bold heading inside.
badge.overview.text: Small labels for statuses and counters. Three styles: solid, soft, outline. Sizes, dots, and numeric counters.
spinner.overview.text: Loading indicators. Four sizes, color variants, three-dot mode, centered wrapper.
spinner.row.center: Flex wrapper that centers a spinner.
skeleton.overview.text: Placeholder shapes that mimic content while it loads.
modal.overview.text: Modals on the native <dialog> element. Focus trap, Escape, click-outside work out of the box.
modal.row.title: Heading.
tabs.overview.text: Three visual styles: underline, filled, vertical. Requires minimal JS to toggle panels.
dropdown.overview.text: Menu that opens on click. Can use <details> for zero-JS use, or a button with JS.
dropdown.row.trigger: The button that opens the menu.
dropdown.row.menu_right: Aligns menu to the right edge.
toast.overview.text: Temporary notifications in a corner. Six position containers, four variants. Auto-dismiss is handled by your JS.
toast.row.leaving: Add before removing to fade out.
pagination.overview.text: Page navigation with numbers, ellipsis, prev/next, and size variants.
breadcrumbs.overview.text: Trail of navigation links. Four separator styles, optional background bar.
tooltip.overview.text: Text bubble on hover or focus. Four placements. No JavaScript, text from a data attribute.
accordion.overview.text: Collapsible sections on native <details>. No JavaScript. Chevron rotates on open, three variants.
accordion.row.separated: Each item is its own card.
avatar.overview.text: Circular or square user representations. Five sizes, three shapes, status indicators, stacked groups.
avatar.row.with_name: Avatar and name side by side.
progress.overview.text: Linear, striped, indeterminate, stacked, circular, plus a styled native <progress>. Bar width set inline via style="width: 60%".
stat.overview.text: Dashboard numbers with a label, trend indicator, icon, and accent stripes.
stat.row.label: Uppercase muted label.
stat.row.suffix: Small unit next to the value.
stat.row.with_icon: Layout with icon block on the left.
empty-state.overview.text: Placeholder for screens with no data. Icon, title, description, action buttons.
empty-state.row.title: Heading.
timeline.overview.text: Chronological list with a vertical connector line and markers. Three layouts: vertical, horizontal, alternating.
timeline.row.title: Event heading.
timeline.row.card: Wraps each event in a card.
timeline.row.alternating: Content on both sides of the line.
overrides.overview.text: Empty file that loads after every other module. Put customizations here. They win without !important. When you upgrade Love.css, this file is not touched.
overrides.what.title: What to put here
overrides.what.li2: New themes: [data-love-theme="sepia"] with your own tokens.
overrides.what.li3: Project-specific components built on top of Love.css primitives.
overrides.what.li4: Small patches when a framework default does not fit.
overrides.notes.li1: If you upgrade and something breaks, this file is the first place to check.
overrides.notes.li2: If you find yourself overriding the same thing three times, open an issue instead.
